verdict.rationale: Conductor's docs say each workspace has its own diff and review path, and that it helps you review the diff before opening a PR and merging. It also surfaces PR failing-check logs, and agents can test repositories and run builds, which covers both diff inspection and checks before merge. Missing for 10: detailed docs on the diff-review UI and on running user-defined checks or test scripts directly, plus independent hands-on corroboration of the review and check workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can inspect diffs and run checks to catch problems before merging

citations.quote: Each task gets its own workspace, branch, files, terminal, diff, and review path.
When the work is ready, Conductor helps you review the diff, open a pull request, merge, and archive the workspace.
PR comments and failing-check logs now load while a cloud workspace is asleep.
The agent can test your repositories, update install and setup scripts, and run builds
